name: e1_quality_grid_jetson
description: E1.3 on the Orin - GPU quality across the grid, one repetition. Uses int8_nofp16, not the default int8: TensorRT's tactic selection for a calibrated INT8 engine with FP16 also enabled is not reproducible — the same ONNX and the same flags produced engines with 0 %, 25 % and 48 % of their layers in INT8 depending on GPU state at build time. With FP16 off the builder has no discretion left and the engine is deterministic, which is what a quality row across 14 grid points needs. The default mixed engine is characterised separately at the operating point.
